MagiKoopasMagicGfx.name: Magikoopa magic graphics, smoke spawn
summary: Draws the Magikoopa's magic sprite as three 8x8 tiles ($88, $89, $98) orbiting the sprite's center on a 16-step circle (MagiKoopasMagicDisp), phase driven by [FrameCounterB].
Tail ($01BD98, called by the magic sprite when it hits something): spawns a puff of smoke (type 1, timer $1B) in the first free of the four smoke slots at $17C0.

InitMagikoopa.name: Init Magikoopa
summary: Erases this sprite if another Magikoopa (sprite $1F) already exists, so only one is ever active. Otherwise clears the kill flag [$18BF].

Magikoopa.name: Magikoopa main
summary: Resets to state 0 when off-screen horizontally, then runs the state in [state] & 3:
0 hidden (waits for a random spot, then fades in), 1 fading in, 2 visible and casting, 3 fading out (then back to 0 after a $10 frame cooldown).

MagiKoopaPtrs.name: Magikoopa states and helpers
summary: Pointer table (hidden, fading in, visible, fading out) followed by the state routines.
State 0 ($01BDF2): picks a random screen position, requires Mario at least $20 pixels away horizontally and ground below, then fades in.
State 1 ($01BE5F) and state 3 ($01BF16): palette fade using CODE_01C004 / CODE_01BFE3.
$01BF1D: spawns the magic sprite ($20) aimed at Mario. $01BF6A: aim routine. A = speed; returns $00 = Y speed, $01 = X speed.
$01BFE3 / $01C004: step the fade timers. $01C028 queues one 16-byte palette block (MagiKoopaPals) for the CGRAM upload at $0681.

s01BE69.name: Data: Magikoopa pose frames, wand offsets

s01BE6E.name: Magikoopa visible state, fade, goal tape init
summary: $01BE6E: state 2. Faces Mario and counts [$1540]: casts the magic at timer $40, then poses and draws with a wand tile, sparkles while the wand is raised.
$01BFE3..$01C061: fade helpers (see above).
$01C062: unused, calls InitGoalTape and moves the sprite up $4C pixels.

InitGoalTape.name: Init goal tape
summary: Stores the tape's X position - 8 in [state], X high in [$151C], Y low/high in [$1528]/[$1534], and the level's extra bits from the Y high byte in [$187B].

GoalTape.name: Goal tape main
summary: Draws the bar, then (unless sprites locked or already triggered) oscillates it vertically and checks Mario against it.
On crossing: sets secret-exit flag [$141C], level clear music, end-of-level timer, awards a bonus by height if Mario touches the bar, then calls TriggerGoalTape.

s01C0A7.name: Goal tape movement, check and draw
summary: $01C0A7: bar movement and Mario crossing test (continuation of GoalTape).
$01C12D: draws the bar as three 8x8 tiles ($D4, $D5, $D5), or after it was hit, animates it and erases it when the timer ends.

GrowingVine.name: Growing vine
summary: Draws the vine head (tile $AC/$AE alternating) and moves it up at speed $F0, generating a vine block (Map16 $03) at every 16 pixels of height.
Drawn behind layers while [$1540] >= $20. Erased when it hits a block or leaves the top of the level.
